metadata.title: पीथमपुर में ज़हरीले कचरे का भय | Pithampur Crisis: Fear of Industrial waste from Union Carbide
metadata.description:
In recent weeks, the industrial town of Pithampur in Madhya Pradesh has been at the centre of a heated controversy. From the spread of misinformation to environmental concerns and industrial unrest, the issue has sparked widespread debate across the state.

This explainer dives into the core of the Pithampur issue — what triggered the unrest, the role of local authorities, and the steps being taken to address public concerns. We'll also look at how the government plans to tackle misinformation through a unique initiative involving 50 master trainers, including professors and science teachers, tasked with countering fake narratives through video content and other mediums.

Stay tuned as we break down the Pithampur crisis, explain its impact on local communities, and explore the government's strategy to ensure the spread of factual information in Madhya Pradesh.
